items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Because even like Marylou -- Marylou played fine, but she was so dainty and so sweet with it, you know ... well, she was.

ctx.x: Uh huh, yeah, she appeared with her, but she is a surprisingly good pianist; she doesn't really play like -- generally, you can put me in one room and let somebody play the piano in another room, and I could tell if it was a woman playing, you know, and that's not to be a chauvinist, but you can. But it's the difference in the touch, you know. But ... you can't tell that with her, she's so strong. She plays strong piano. She really attacks it, you know.
Because even like Marylou -- Marylou played fine, but she was so dainty and so sweet with it, you know ... well, she was.
